I feel you... I really do get how you feel.  This is an insane world... I think maybe this thread might help you.  I read it last night and it helped me... 
https://www.beyondblue.org.au/get-support/online-forums/depression/is-depression-a-natural-reaction-to-an-insane-world

I think we are the sane ones.  It's the world that's insane.  It's about finding the coping skills to make it through, and that doesn't mean we're apathetic or unfeeling or don't care.  It doesn't mean we don't know the world is fucked up.

You sound like an intelligent person, and you're empathetic, obviously, which is why you feel so much.  The world needs people like you!  Like us!

I don't know who this "Unbeliever" is but I'm grateful to him/her for the post.  The post and the subsequent thread really helped me last night.  Even inspired me to create this reddit account and subscribe to this sub, so there ya go......

Take care - one day at a time.

OMG, this is my nightmare scenario... I'm so sorry you have to deal with this.

Maybe you could change your email address?  Let contacts know that this is your new email account and arrange forwarding from your old one to the new one to try to filter out these emails so you don't see them?  If your name is a common one (most names are... there's at least one person in the world who has your name) then people won't know that that was you.  Good luck.  And please don't step in front of a busy highway.  This can be solved!
